nodes.name: CF@Zn-MOF
aliases: 2D Zn-MOF nanosheet arrays on carbon fibers

properties.description: Carbon fiber coated with NiCoZn layered double hydroxide and Co9S8 quantum dots

nodes.name: Zn-MOF Growth on CF
nodes.procedure: Carbon fiber cloth (CF, 1×2 cm²) was cleaned up with acetone, ethanol, and DI water for 20 min, respectively. Zn(NO3)2·6H2O (40 mL × 50×10^{-3} M) was added into 2MI (40 mL × 0.4 M). Then, a piece of CF (2×1 cm²) was put into the as-prepared mixed solution. After 12 h, the CF was washed with DI water and dried at 60 °C for 24 h.
nodes.source_text: Preparation of CF@Zn-MOF: First, Zn(NO3)2·6H2O (40 mL × 50×10^{-3} M) was added into 2MI (40 mL × 0.4 M)... dried at 60 °C for 24 h.

nodes.name: NiCoZn-LDH Coprecipitation
nodes.procedure: NiCl2·6H2O and CoCl2·6H2O (a total concentration of 3×10^{-3} M with Ni/Co=2/1) were dissolved in 50 mL autoclave with 30 mL DI water, forming a mixed solution. Then, a piece of as-obtained CF@Zn-MOF was immersed into the mixed solution at 120 °C for 24 h. Finally, the sample was cleaned with DI water and dried at 60 °C.
nodes.source_text: Preparation of CF@NiCoZn-LDH: CF@NiCoZn-LDH was synthesized via a coprecipitation and ion etching process. First, NiCl2·6H2O and CoCl2·6H2O (a total concentration of 3×10^{-3} M) were dissolved in 50 mL autoclave with 30 mL DI water... at 120 °C for 24 h.

nodes.name: Selective Co Vulcanization
nodes.procedure: Firstly, 0.3 mmol TAA (30 mg) was dissolved in 20 mL ethanol solution and stirred gently for 30 min. Then, the solution was transferred into a 50 mL Teflon-lined autoclave and a piece of as-prepared CF@Ni2Co1Zn-LDH was immersed into the solution. The obtained CF@NiCoZn-LDH/Co9S8-QD was taken out after 2.5 h at 120 °C and washed with DI water.

maximum energy density of 56.4 Wh kg−1 at a power density of 875.0 W kg−1 and still reaches 42 Wh kg−1 at a high-power density of 8200.0 W kg−1... outstanding capacitance retention of 95.3% after 8000 charge–discharge cycles... nodes.source_text: a series of cyclic voltammetry (CV) profiles was measured at 5 mV s−1 (Figure S2, Supporting Information), and we found that the CF@Ni2Co1Zn-LDH has the optimal capacity performance

nodes.description: Three-electrode CV curves at various scan rates
nodes.source_text: the percent capacitive contribution of CF@NiCoZn-LDH/Co9S8-QD (21%) is evidently higher than that of CF@Ni2Co1Zn-LDH (14%) at a scan rate of 5 mV s−1... the percent capacitive contribution of the CF@NiCoZn-LDH/Co9S8-QD increases from 16% to 81% at variable scan rates from 2 to 100 mV s−1

nodes.description: Three-electrode GCD curves comparison at 5 A/g
nodes.source_text: via the comparative analysis of the GCD curves, the electrochemical capacity performance of the finally synthesized CF@NiCoZn-LDH/Co9S8-QD is obviously superior to that of CF@Ni2Co1Zn-LDH
the CF@NiCoZn-LDH/Co9S8-QD displays a lower charge-transfer impedance and bulk resistance without obvious semicircles than LDHs

nodes.characterization_summary: Zn-MOF displays uniform triangular nanosheets with average thickness 130 nm and smooth surface. Ni2Co1Zn-LDH shows curly nanosheets ≈100 nm thick. NiCoZn-LDH/Co9S8-QD maintains nanoarray structure with rough surface and embedded QDs, average thickness ≈80 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 2b reveals that the as-obtained Zn-MOF displays a uniform pattern of triangular nanosheets with an average thickness of 130 nm... the surface of the vulcanized nanosheets changed from smooth (Figure 2f) to rough with embedded Co9S8-QDs (Figure 2i).

nodes.characterization_summary: NiCoZn-LDH/Co9S8-QD shows Co9S8-QDs gradually embedded in LDH nanosheets as vulcanization time increases to 2.5 h. Nanosheets have smooth interface before vulcanization.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in the magnified TEM images (Figure 3a–d), as the vulcanization time increased from 0 to 2.5 h, the Co9S8-QDs gradually increased and embedded within the NiCoZn-LDH nanosheet in situ.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiCoZn-LDH shows interplanar distances of 2.6 Å (012) and 2.3 Å (110). Co9S8-QD shows 2.8 Å (222) with average diameter 6 nm and lattice deformations.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The interplanar distances of 2.6 and 2.3 Å match well with the (012) and (110) planes of the Ni2Co1Zn-LDH phase, respectively. The interplanar distance of 2.8 Å corresponds to the (222) plane of the Co9S8 phase.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiCoZn-LDH/Co9S8-QD shows homogeneous distribution of Ni, Co, Zn, O, S elements.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The corresponding EDS element mappings of the NiCoZn-LDH/Co9S8-QD are shown in Figure 3g, indicating a homogenous distribution of the Ni, Co, Zn, S, and O in the hybrid nanosheet electrode.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiCoZn-LDH shows diffraction peaks at (003), (006), (012), (013), (015), (018), (110), (115). After vulcanization, new peaks at (222), (400) confirm cubic Co9S8 phase (JCPDS no. 75-2023).
nodes.evidence_snippet: After selective vulcanization, two new obvious diffraction peaks indexed to the (222) and (400) planes appear in the pattern, which correspond to the characteristics of the cubic Co9S8 phase (JCPDS no. 75-2023).

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni2Co1Zn-LDH: Co 2p3/2 at 778.9 eV, Co 2p1/2 at 797.6 eV (ΔE=15.3 eV). NiCoZn-LDH/Co9S8-QD: Co 2p3/2 at 781.0 eV, Co 2p1/2 at 796.8 eV (ΔE=15.8 eV), O 1s shift of 0.8 eV. Ni 2p and Zn 2p unchanged, S 2p confirms Co9S8.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Co 2p of Ni2Co1Zn-LDH exhibits two spin-orbit doublets of Co 2p3/2 and Co 2p1/2 that correspond to a low energy peak of 778.9 eV and a high energy peak of 797.6 eV... After vulcanization, the two peaks are shifted to lower binding energies of 781.0 eV (Co 2p3/2) and 796.8 eV (Co 2p1/2).

nodes.characterization_summary: NiCoZn-LDH/Co9S8-QD shows S content of 5.21 wt% at optimal vulcanization and Ni/Co molar ratio of 1.85:1.
nodes.evidence_snippet: According to the inductively coupled plasma-optical emission spectrometry elemental analysis... when the weight percentage of S is 5.21 wt%, the optimal loading of Co9S8-QDs can be accurately located. Moreover, the molar ratio of Ni/Co in NiCoZn-LDH/Co9S8-QD is 1.85:1.
